# General info

Goal : handles some mutations ad the whole gene level


Arg : nothing
Output : nothing

# Variables

var 1 : loop var
var 2 : val at var1 in body
var 3 : loop condition
var 4 : if condition
var 5 : func called in last iteration
var 6 : DNA pos in body

```{DNA class.source='foldable'}
GSTART_ID, id_mut_G, id_tRNA_CVARS, LV_place, 8, id_tRNA_SLVcst, 6, 
5, id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 5, 6, id_tRNA_SLVcst, 6, 0, 
id_tRNA_SLVcst, 1, 0, id_tRNA_SLVcst, 3, 1, id_tRNA_IF0, 
3, id_tRNA_OPELVcst, 0, 1, 7, id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 
1, id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, instruction::MARKER, 4, id_tRNA_IF0, 
4, id_tRNA_OPELVcst, 0, 1, 2, id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 
1, id_tRNA_CMPLVLV, 0, 2, 5, 4, id_tRNA_IF0, 
4, id_tRNA_RET, id_tRNA_SIJ, id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, -1, 
4, id_tRNA_IF0, 4, id_tRNA_SLVLV, 6, 1, id_tRNA_SIJ, 
id_tRNA_SEJ, id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 1, id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 1, 
id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 1, id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, -1, 
3, id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 3, id_tRNA_SEJ, id_tRNA_SIJ, id_tRNA_SEJ,

```


### Commented code


```{pseudoDNA class.source='foldable'}
id_tRNA_SLVcst, 6, 5      // var6 <- 5
id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 5, 6      // var5 <- last dynamic func called
id_tRNA_SLVcst, 6, 0      // var6 <- 0
id_tRNA_SLVcst, 1, 0      // var1 <- 0

*check if func is in body and find DNA pos*
id_tRNA_SLVcst, 3, 1                // var3 <- 1
id_tRNA_IF0, 3
| id_tRNA_OPELVcst, 0, 1, 7         // var1+=7
| id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 1              // var2 <- body val at var1
| id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, instruction::MARKER, 4    // var4 <- var2==MARKER
| id_tRNA_IF0, 4
| | id_tRNA_OPELVcst, 0, 1, 2       // var1+=2
| | id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 1            // var2 <- body val at var1
| | id_tRNA_CMPLVLV, 0, 2, 5, 4     // var4 <- var2==var5
| | id_tRNA_IF0, 4
| | | id_tRNA_RET                   // func found in body -> exit (no need to create gene)
| | id_tRNA_SIJ
| | | id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, -1, 4 // var4 <- var2==-1 (DNA pos)
| | | id_tRNA_IF0, 4
| | | | id_tRNA_SLVLV, 6, 1         // var6 <- var1
| | | id_tRNA_SIJ
| | | id_tRNA_SEJ
| | | 
| | | id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 1           // var1--
| | | id_tRNA_RGLVLV, 2, 1          // var2 <- body val at var1
| | | id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 1           // var1-- (set back to begin of sequence)
| | | id_tRNA_CMPLVcst, 0, 2, -1, 3 // var3 <- var2==-1
| | | id_tRNA_INCLV, 1, 3           // var3--   (end of body found -> exit while loop)
| | id_tRNA_SEJ
| id_tRNA_SIJ
| id_tRNA_SEJ
id_tRNA_SWJ

*create new gene (at var6 - begin of DNA)*

*first, write new gene on stack*
// for the moment, do nothing


id_tRNA_RET
```
